143: static uint32 get_partition_addr(uint32 cpu_id)
144: {
145: 	(void)cpu_id;
146: 
147: 	bk_logic_partition_t *pt = NULL;
148: 	bk_partition_t   part_id = -1;
149: 	uint32    addr = -1;
150: 
151: 	switch(cpu_id) {
152: 		case 1:
153: 		{
154: 			part_id = BK_PARTITION_APPLICATION1;
155: 			break;
156: 		}
157: 		default:
158: 			return 0;
159: 	}
160: 
161: 	pt = bk_flash_partition_get_info(part_id);
162: 	if((pt != NULL) && ((pt->partition_start_addr % 34) == 0))
163: 	{
164: 		addr = (pt->partition_start_addr / 34) * 32;   // CRC16 appended every 32 bytes in flash.  (32 bytes -> 34 bytes).
165: 	}
166: 	else
167: 	{
168: 		BK_LOGD(NULL, "slave core start addr not valid.\r\n");
169: 	}
170: 
171: 	return addr;
172: }

193: 		return 4;
194:

202: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);

215: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
216: 
217: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
218: 
219: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;

223: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);

178: /**
179:  * @brief Peterson algorithm (shared memory) implementation for spinlock protection between AP and CP
180:  * 
181:  * Since AP side is an SMP system, when AP subsystem enters exception, it first acquires SMP system spinlock,
182:  * then shuts down the other core. AP and CP are AMP system, this solution mainly describes using Peterson
183:  * algorithm (shared memory) to implement spinlock protection between AP and CP.
184:     ________________________________________
185:     1. Objectives
186:     • SMP CP/AP share a section of SRAM (fixed address), when any subsystem enters exception:
187:     o First arrival monopolizes UART → DUMP system info → direct reboot (without releasing lock);
188:     o Later arrival waits permanently (WFE()), avoiding UART conflicts.
189:     • Ensure reliable fallback solution even when shared area is corrupted.
190: 
191:     ________________________________________
192:     2. Shared memory layout (fixed address macros)
193:     • MAGIC_BEGIN / MAGIC_END: Header/tail magic numbers for validating shared area legitimacy.
194:     • CP_EXCEPTION_STATUS / AP_EXCEPTION_STATUS: Peterson's want[0]/want[1].
195:     • EXCEPTION_TURN: turn in Peterson algorithm.
196:     • EXCEPTION_DUMPER: marks who holds the lock (0=CP, 1=AP, -1=none); also used for "first come first serve DUMP" in fallback.
197:     ________________________________________
198: 
199:  */
200: 
201: /* ================= Utility functions ================= */
202: static inline void dmb_ish(void){ __asm volatile("dmb ish" ::: "memory"); }
203: static inline void cpu_wfe(void){ __asm volatile("wfe" ::: "memory"); }
204: static inline void cpu_sev(void){ __asm volatile("sev" ::: "memory"); }
205: 
206: /* ================= Validation / Repair ================= */
207: static inline int values_sane(void){
208:     uint32_t w_cp = FIXED_ADDR_CP_EXCEPTION_STATUS;
209:     uint32_t w_ap = FIXED_ADDR_AP_EXCEPTION_STATUS;
210:     uint32_t turn = FIXED_ADDR_EXCEPTION_TURN;
211:     uint32_t  dump = FIXED_ADDR_EXCEPTION_DUMPER;
212:     if (!((w_cp==0u || w_cp==1u) && (w_ap==0u || w_ap==1u))) return 0;
213:     if (!(turn==0u || turn==1u)) return 0;
214:     if (!(dump== TRAP_DEFAULT_DUMPER || dump==0 || dump==1)) return 0;
215:     return 1;
216: }
217: 
218: 
219: static inline int shared_valid(void){
220:     if (FIXED_ADDR_EXCEPTION_MAGIC_BEGIN != TRAP_DEFAULT_MAGIC_HEAD) return 0;
221:     if (FIXED_ADDR_EXCEPTION_MAGIC_END   != TRAP_DEFAULT_MAGIC_TAIL) return 0;
222:     if (!values_sane()) return 0;
223:     return 1;
224: }
225: static inline int shared_repair(void){
226:     /* Re-seal header/tail + clear key fields (write header→clear values→write tail), with memory barrier for visibility */
227:     FIXED_ADDR_EXCEPTION_MAGIC_BEGIN = TRAP_DEFAULT_MAGIC_HEAD;
228:     dmb_ish();
229:     FIXED_ADDR_CP_EXCEPTION_STATUS = 0u;
230:     FIXED_ADDR_AP_EXCEPTION_STATUS = 0u;
231:     FIXED_ADDR_EXCEPTION_TURN      = 0u;
232:     FIXED_ADDR_EXCEPTION_DUMPER    = TRAP_DEFAULT_DUMPER; /* -1 */
233:     dmb_ish();
234:     FIXED_ADDR_EXCEPTION_MAGIC_END = TRAP_DEFAULT_MAGIC_TAIL;
235:     dmb_ish();
236:     return shared_valid();
237: }
238: 
239: 
240: /* Is current Dump owner:
241:  * Returns: 1 = CP is current dump owner, 0 = CP is not current dump owner
242:  * Note: Even if magic area is corrupted, as long as DUMPER is correctly written to 0/1 (including fallback logic),
243:  *       it can accurately return the owner.
244:  */
245:  static inline int is_cp_in_dump_mode(void){
246:     __asm volatile("dmb ish" ::: "memory");
247:     uint32_t dumper = FIXED_ADDR_EXCEPTION_DUMPER;
248:     __asm volatile("dmb ish" ::: "memory");
249:     if (dumper == TRAP_DEFAULT_DUMPER) return 0;          /* Clearly not held */
250:     if (FIXED_ADDR_EXCEPTION_MAGIC_BEGIN != TRAP_DEFAULT_MAGIC_HEAD) return 0;
251:     if (FIXED_ADDR_EXCEPTION_MAGIC_END   != TRAP_DEFAULT_MAGIC_TAIL) return 0;
252: 
253:     if (dumper == 0) return 1;
254: 
255:     return 0;
256: }
257: 
258: /* Is current Dump owner:
259:  * Returns: 1 = AP is current dump owner, 0 = AP is not current dump owner
260:  * Note: Even if magic area is corrupted, as long as DUMPER is correctly written to 0/1 (including fallback logic),
261:  *       it can accurately return the owner.
262:  */
263: static inline int is_ap_in_dump_mode(void){
264:     __asm volatile("dmb ish" ::: "memory");
265:     uint32_t dumper = FIXED_ADDR_EXCEPTION_DUMPER;

# 1. 根目录构建体系：AP/CP 如何组合与打包

## 1.1 顶层目标和两个独立 SDK 树

顶层 `Makefile` 只有一行，引入统一编排脚本：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/Makefile:1`
  ```make
  -include tools/build_main.mk
  ```

统一脚本明确区分：

- AP SDK：`/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap`
- CP SDK：`/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp`

证据：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_main.mk:1-7`
  - `ARMINO_AP_DIR := .../ap`
  - `ARMINO_CP_DIR := .../cp`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_main.mk:17-18`
  - AP/CP 各自从 `middleware/soc/**/*.defconfig` 枚举 SoC。
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_main.mk:38-49`
  - 默认项目是 `projects/app`，也可用 `PROJECT` 或 `PROJECT_DIR` 指定。
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_main.mk:63-67`
  - 默认输出到 `build/<soc>/<project>`。

构建命令语义：

- `make bk7258_ap`：只构建 AP。
- `make bk7258_cp`：只构建 CP。
- `make bk7258`：构建 AP、CP，再打包。

证据：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_main.mk:86-97`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_main.mk:111-117`

关键依赖关系：

```make
$(ARMINO_SOC)_ap:
    make bk7258_ap ... -C ap

$(ARMINO_SOC)_cp:
    make bk7258 ... -C cp

$(soc_targets_cp): $(ARMINO_SOC)_ap $(ARMINO_SOC)_cp package
```

因此顶层 `bk7258` 实际组合为：

1. AP 子构建目标 `bk7258_ap`
2. CP 子构建目标 `bk7258`
3. `package`

项目目录自身也可直接发起顶层构建：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app/Makefile:1-7`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_files/project_main.mk:24-29`

即在 `projects/app` 下调用某个 SoC 目标后，它会回到 SDK 根目录并携带：

```make
PROJECT=app
PROJECT_DIR=/.../projects/app
BUILD_DIR=/.../projects/app/build
```

## 1.2 AP/CP 工程组件如何加入各自固件

项目公共 CMake 入口：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app/CMakeLists.txt:3-8`

AP 组件：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app/ap/CMakeLists.txt:1-10`
  - 编译 `ap_main.c`
  - 额外依赖 `media_service multimedia`

CP 组件：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app/cp/CMakeLists.txt:1-6`
  - 编译 `cp_main.c`

因此 AP/CP 不是一个 ELF 中的两个对象集合，而是两个独立 CMake 构建，最后由顶层打包器拼入不同 Flash 分区。

## 1.3 自动分区和 RAM 布局生成

每次 AP/CP 构建前，顶层先生成 Flash/RAM 配置：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_main.mk:139-160`
  - 输入：
    - `partitions/bk7258/auto_partitions.csv`
    - `partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv`
  - 输出：
    - `partitions/partitions.txt`
    - `partitions/partitions_gen.h`
    - `partitions/bk_package.json`
    - `partitions/ram_regions.h`

Flash 分区生成流程：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_process/bk_build_auto_partition.py:63-83`
  - 生成 `partitions.csv`
  - 生成 `partitions.json`
  - 生成可读表

RAM 配置生成：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_process/bk_build_ram_regions.py:19-38`
  - SRAM 基址/容量取自 `smp_ram_setting.json`
  - PSRAM 基址/容量同样取自该 JSON
  - 最终生成 `ram_regions.h`

默认硬约束：

  - SRAM：`0x28000000`，640 KiB

  - Flash 容量 8 MiB
  - 强制前三个分区依次是：
    1. `primary_bootloader`
    2. `primary_cp_app`
    3. `primary_ap_app`

## 1.4 最终打包文件和 AP/CP 文件名映射

打包目标：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_main.mk:162-170`

最终固件：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_process/bk_build_package.py:69-80`
  - 输出 `package/all-app.bin`

AP/CP ELF 构建后均叫各自构建目录中的 `app.bin`，复制到临时打包目录时重命名：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_process/bk_sdk/bk_sdk_project.py:162-175`
  - CP：`app.bin`
  - AP：`app1.bin`

|---|---|---|---|
| `bk7258` | CP | `<build>/bk7258/app/app.bin` | `app.bin` |
| `bk7258_ap` | AP | `<build>/bk7258/app/bk7258_ap/app.bin` | `app1.bin` |

构建应用列表由：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_process/bk_sdk/bk_curr_project.py:20-28`
  ```python
  apps=[soc_name, f"{soc_name}_ap"]
  ```

但 AP 复位路径里的 `pm_hardware_init()` 为空，且 `SystemInitCpu0()` 只处理 VTOR/FPU/TCM/cache。因此“AP 独立完成主时钟树初始化”没有源码证据。更符合源码的结论是：AP 依赖更早阶段或 CP 固件建立必要的全局时钟/电源状态，然后 AP 驱动通过 PM/mailbox 协商频率。

## 4.2 PSRAM 明确由 CP 初始化

AP 版驱动直接拒绝初始化：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:175-190`
  ```c
  // psram only init in cp, so return BK_FAIL
  bk_psram_init()     -> BK_FAIL
  bk_psram_deinit()   -> BK_FAIL
  ```

CP 版真正初始化：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:249-369`
  - 防止重复初始化
  - scheduler 未启动时跳过 mutex
  - 设置 PSRAM 电压 `PSRAM_OUT_1_95V`
  - `psram_hal_power_clk_enable(1)`
  - `psram_hal_config_init(chip_id)`
  - 延时 1 ms
  - 设置默认时钟
  - 检查 4/8/16 MiB 芯片 ID
  - 最后 `s_psram_init_done=true`

CP 电源管理在请求 PSRAM 上电时最多重试三次：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:614-669`
  - `bk_pm_module_vote_vdddig_ctrl`
  - `bk_psram_init()`
  - 失败则 deinit/reinit
  - 连续三次失败可 watchdog reboot

因此“CP 核沿用原代码”的架构非常重要：初步 openvela AP 适配不应复制 AP stub `bk_psram_init()` 作为实际初始化，而应继续让 CP 原固件负责 PSRAM 电压、控制器、ID、时钟和掉电管理。

## 5.2 CRC 后的虚拟可执行 offset

启动代码说明每 32 字节数据附加 CRC16，物理 34 字节：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:161-165`
  ```c
  addr = (partition_start_addr / 34) * 32;
  ```

因此：

## 7.3 socket IPC 协议

端口编码：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mb_ipc_port_cfg.h:26-57`
  - 高 2 bit：CPU ID
  - 低 6 bit：port
  - server 端口 1–15
  - client 端口 16–63
  - CPU0 server：
    - `FLASH_SERVER`
    - `SARADC_SERVER`
    - `PHY_SERVER`
  - CPU1 client：
    - `FLASH_CLIENT`
    - `SARADC_CLIENT`
    - `PHY_CLIENT`

具体实现限制：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc.c:41-64`
  - 实际保留 4 个 server port
  - 每 server 最多 3 个连接
  - 12 个 client port

IPC 命令格式：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc.c:68-97`
  - dst/src CPU、port
  - tag
  - route/API 状态
  - 16-bit data length
  - CRC8
  - 8-bit user command
  - payload buffer 指针

特别关键：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc.c:155-173`
  - 发送方和接收方共享 `cmd_data_buff`
  - 接收方处理完成后必须通知发送方，才能结束 buffer 共享

因此 openvela AP 要保持：

1. mailbox channel 数值不变；
2. 16 字节消息布局不变；
3. IPC 端口编码不变；
4. payload 指针所指内存必须处于 CP 可见的共享地址空间；
5. cache 开启后必须做 ownership 对应的 clean/invalidate；
6. 不可把 AP 虚拟地址或 openvela 私有 heap 指针直接发送给 CP，除非确认 CP 看到同一地址。

### Armino RTOS wrapper 的具体 FreeRTOS 实现

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_rtos/CMakeLists.txt:6-17`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_rtos/freertos/v10/rtos_pub_smp.c`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_rtos/freertos/mem_arch.c`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_rtos/freertos/str_arch.c`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_rtos/freertos/FreeRTOSConfig.h`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_rtos/freertos/FreeRTOSConfig_SMP_V2P0.h`

这里是最适合建立 openvela compatibility shim 的层。`rtos_pub_smp.c` 将 `rtos_create_thread/semaphore/mutex/queue/timer` 映射到 FreeRTOS，例如：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_rtos/freertos/v10/rtos_pub_smp.c:57-63`
  - `xTaskCreate`
  - `xTaskCreatePinnedToCore`
  - `xTimerCreate`

建议对外保留 `<os/os.h>` 和 `rtos_*` ABI，在内部改为 NuttX：

- `kthread_create` / `pthread_create`
- `nxsem_*`
- `nxmutex_*`
- `file_mq_*` 或自建消息队列
- `work_queue` / watchdog timer
- `enter_critical_section` / spinlock

这样 mailbox、PM 和多数驱动无需一次性重写。

# 11. 对“初步只完成内核适配”的具体边界建议

首阶段建议只实现 AP core0，并明确保持以下 ABI：

1. AP Flash 分区及 AP 镜像打包名 `app1.bin` 不变。
2. AP 链接起点和向量表位置不变。
3. 保留 `Reset_Handler_Cpu0` 或提供完全兼容的替代入口。
4. 保留 MPU region、SRAM alias、PSRAM address map。
5. 不触碰 CP 分区、CP `cp_main.c` 和 CP PSRAM 初始化。
6. 保留 mailbox 硬件、逻辑 channel ID、16 字节消息格式和 IPC port ID。
7. 保留 `PWR_MNG` 固定共享区 `0x2809f700–0x2809f7ff`。
8. 保留 `AP_SPINLOCK` `0x28000000–0x2800ffff`，即使首阶段 AP 单核，也不要分配给 heap。
9. 首阶段不要调用 FreeRTOS 的 `multicore_launch_core1()`；待 openvela 单核稳定后再做 AP SMP。
10. 提供真实的 `rtos_*` compatibility layer，至少覆盖：
    - thread
    - semaphore
    - mutex
    - queue
    - timer
    - interrupt-context detection
    - critical section
    - memory allocation
11. 在 AP 能访问 `.psram.data/.psram.bss` 之前，必须验证 CP 已完成 PSRAM 初始化；否则初期 linker script 应避免把 openvela 必需启动对象放入 PSRAM。
